text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: 'Issue Number'
        required: true
        type: string
      instructions:
        description: 'Optional Instructions'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  claude-code:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Verify maintainer permissions
        id: verify-permissions
        run: |
          curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
               -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
               https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/collaborators/${{ github.actor }} | jq '.permissions.push' > /dev/null
          echo "::set-output name=is-maintainer::$(jq -r .permissions.push < /dev/null)"

      - name: Run Claude Code
        if: steps.verify-permissions.outputs.is-maintainer == 'true'
        id: run-claude
        run: npx claudie-code --issue ${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }} --instructions ${{ github.event.inputs.instructions }}
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

      - name: Create draft PR
        if: steps.run-claude.outputs.has-changes == 'true'
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
          git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
          git checkout -b claude-code-pr
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore: update code based on Claude Code"
          gh pr create --draft --title "Chore: Update code based on Claude Code" --body "This PR was automatically generated by the Claude Code GitHub Actions workflow."
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
